_: Which recitations the reader can choose between. `id` is both the folder on the audio bucket and the name of the timing files beside each surah — public/surah/<n>/<nnn>.<id>.timing.json — so adding one is a matter of putting its files there and naming it here. `default` is what a reader who has never chosen gets, and what the surah pages describe to a crawler. `note` tells two recordings by the same reciter apart; it is what the picker shows under the name, so it has to say the thing a listener would actually notice.
